key_highlights: Australian unemployment surges to a five-year high, effectively extinguishing RBA rate hike expectations and triggering an AUD sell-off.
ASX registers a third consecutive week of gains led by mining and technology sectors, defying domestic macro softening.
Sydney auction market slides into crash mode as housing market stress intensifies amid rising joblessness.
Global markets confront 'China Shock 2.0' industrial overcapacity and US political friction, threatening international trade flows.

sectors.trend: Miners lift the ASX to weekly gains alongside junior gold fast-tracking and critical minerals advances, counterbalancing China export risks.
sectors.implications: Supports gold producers and critical minerals plays; bulk miners face demand scrutiny from Chinese industrial shifts.

sectors.trend: Spiking unemployment and auction market distress heighten credit impairment concerns, offsetting relief from peak RBA rate expectations.
sectors.implications: Increased net interest margin compression and asset quality headwinds for major mortgage lenders.

sectors.trend: Tech equities rally in tandem with miners, bolstered by falling domestic bond yields following weak labor data.
sectors.implications: Multiples expansion for ASX tech names as lower terminal rate expectations ease valuation headwinds.

sectors.trend: Domestic gas volatility persists alongside heightened legal and regulatory scrutiny over net-zero emissions mandates.
sectors.implications: Operational and compliance uncertainty for domestic gas producers and heavy industrial energy consumers.

sectors.trend: Sydney residential property auction market deteriorates while mortgage repayment relief emerges in select regional pockets.
sectors.implications: Downside risks for residential developers; commercial REITs benefit marginally from stabilizing yield curves.

key_themes: Divergence between resilient equity index performance and deteriorating domestic macroeconomic indicators.
Labor market inflection eliminating RBA rate hike risks and putting pressure on the Australian dollar.
Residential property market downturn driven by five-year high unemployment and borrowing capacity limits.
Global trade headwinds linked to Chinese deflationary export pressures and US political volatility.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight consumer discretionary; prioritize defensive yield and consumer staples.
Reduce exposure to retail banking majors with concentrated high-LVR mortgage books.
Hedge base metal exposure and focus on precious metals with safe-haven attributes.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Domestic Gas Market Disruption & Net-Zero Regulatory Risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favor energy producers with unencumbered offshore revenue streams and minimal domestic legal overhang.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold producers and near-term production developers.
opportunities.rationale: Strong commodity price backdrop, lower real yields, and rapid project advancement provide defensive capital growth.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical allocation to quality ASX technology leaders.
opportunities.rationale: Declining peak interest rate expectations provide multiple support after extended consolidation.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to major domestic commercial banks.
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising unemployment to five-year highs and auction market weakness increase default risks and cap credit growth.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge broad market exposure against macro divergence risks.
defensive_moves.rationale: Three-week ASX rally vulnerable to pullbacks as labor weakness and China risks filter into earnings forecasts.

market_outlook.short_term: Rangebound ASX 200 (^AXJO) trading. Rate cut speculation offsets weakening macro data, but housing and labor deterioration limit near-term upside.
market_outlook.long_term: Medium-term support from eventual RBA easing cycle, though economic recovery depends on stabilization in China and domestic consumer solvency.
